title: Halofuginone-Mediated Metabolic Reprogramming of Murine T Cells via GCN2 Pathway Activation
author: Kates, St. Paul, et al.

steps.title: Prepare culture media
steps.instruction: Prepare complete RPMI medium for bone‑marrow derived dendritic cell culture and complete IMDM medium for T‑cell culture as described in the Materials and Equipment section (≈15 min total).

substeps.instruction: Prepare complete RPMI media for BMDC culture.
Prepare complete IMDM media for T‑cell culture.

steps.title: Harvest spleen and lymph nodes
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet on ice, add ~6 mL sterile 1× PBS to one well of a 6‑well plate and place a 70 µm filter on the liquid; euthanize a 6–10‑week‑old P14 mouse with 5 % isoflurane (1 L/min O₂) followed by cervical dislocation, spray with 70 % ethanol, make a midline skin incision and peel back skin, collect inguinal lymph nodes from both flanks with sterile tweezers, make an incision along the left flank to expose the peritoneum, make a small peritoneal incision to expose the spleen, gently pull out the spleen and separate it from pancreas and surrounding tissue, and place all harvested tissues into the 70 µm filter; keep the plate on ice throughout.

substeps.instruction: Add ~6 mL 1× PBS to a 6‑well plate and place a 70 µm filter on the liquid.
Euthanize mouse with 5 % isoflurane (1 L/min O₂) then cervical dislocation; spray with 70 % ethanol.
Incise midline, peel back skin, and collect inguinal lymph nodes from both flanks.
Incise left flank, expose peritoneum, make a small peritoneal incision, and harvest spleen.
Place spleen and lymph nodes into the filter; keep on ice.

steps.title: Isolate CD8+ T cells
steps.instruction: Mash spleen and lymph node tissue through the 70 µm filter using the plunger of a 3 mL syringe, strain the cell suspension into a sterile 50 mL tube, centrifuge at 450 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant; add 100 µL CD8‑T‑cell antibody‑biotin cocktail and 400 µL MACS buffer, mix, incubate 10 min on ice; add 200 µL anti‑biotin microbeads and 300 µL MACS buffer, mix, incubate 15 min on ice; bring volume to 5 mL with MACS buffer, centrifuge 450 × g 5 min 4 °C; set up an LS column on a magnetic rack over a clean 15 mL tube, wash column with 3 mL MACS buffer, load the cell suspension, wash with an additional 3 mL MACS buffer, collect flow‑through, add 5 mL HBSS to the tube, centrifuge 450 × g 5 min 4 °C, resuspend pellet in complete IMDM, count cells, dilute to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL with complete IMDM, and keep the isolated T cells on ice until BMDC collection is finished.

substeps.instruction: Mash spleen and lymph nodes through the 70 µm filter with a 3 mL syringe plunger.
Filter the cell suspension into a sterile 50 mL tube and centrifuge 450 × g 5 min at 4 °C; remove supernatant.
Label cells with 100 µL CD8‑T‑cell antibody‑biotin cocktail and 400 µL MACS buffer; incubate 10 min on ice.
Add 200 µL anti‑biotin microbeads and 300 µL MACS buffer; incubate 15 min on ice.
Adjust volume to 5 mL with MACS buffer and centrifuge 450 × g 5 min at 4 °C.
Set up LS column on magnetic rack over a clean 15 mL tube; wash column with 3 mL MACS buffer.
Load cell suspension onto column, then wash with 3 mL plain MACS buffer; collect flow‑through.
Add 5 mL HBSS to the tube (not through column) and centrifuge 450 × g 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend pellet in complete IMDM, count cells, dilute to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL with complete IMDM, and keep on ice.
